title: Ep 19 — OpenAI and Google break a quiet streak in one day, and the video-screening hiring tool quietly earning thirteen thousand five hundred a month
description: OpenAI brings its cheaper GPT five point six models to Amazon's Kiro coding-agent platform and Google gives Gemini the ability to build interactive three-dee models and simulations mid-chat, breaking two quiet weeks from the big three in a single day. Plus a deep dive on async video-screening tool Hirevire, founder Sanat Hegde's four-year bootstrap to roughly thirteen thousand five hundred dollars a month verified through Stripe, niched for Steve's audience as a safeguarding-vetting feature for LeaguePages' grassroots clubs, and why this Thursday's Department for Transport EV charging-point statistics matter for EV-Partnerships.
